# Model Barbers

> Williamsburg's neighborhood barbershop. Walk-ins only. Cash only. 497 Union Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211. Phone (718) 387-9487.

Model Barbers is a barbershop in Williamsburg, Brooklyn. The barbers are Roman, Jack, and Alik. The shop's line is "Leave a brand new man."

The shop has moved. It is now at 497 Union Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211, just down the street from the old shop at 452 Union Ave. The new address has no unit number. The previous address was 452 Union Ave #3427, Brooklyn, NY 11211.

This file repeats only facts published on the Model Barbers website. It does not add awards, social accounts, or a founding year.

## Location

- Street address: 497 Union Ave, Brooklyn, NY 11211
- Previous address: 452 Union Ave #3427, Brooklyn, NY 11211
- Neighborhood: Williamsburg, Brooklyn
- Map: https://maps.google.com/?q=497+Union+Ave,+Brooklyn,+NY+11211
- By subway: L train to Lorimer St or Graham Ave, then a short walk along Union Ave
- By car: street parking on Union Ave and nearby blocks (check signs for alternate-side rules)

The homepage caption and the scrolling line on the home page say "Est. 1920s."

## Hours

- Monday–Friday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Saturday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM
- Sunday: Closed

The website says the shop opens at 9 AM, earlier than most shops in the neighborhood.

## How a visit works

- Walk-ins only. No appointment needed. The shop does not take appointments online and does not have an app.
- If you are on a tight schedule, call ahead and the shop will tell you the current wait.
- Most haircuts take 15–20 minutes.
- Payment: cash only.
- Prices on the website were confirmed as of 2025. Call to verify.

## Services and prices

- Men's haircut: $30. Classic cut to any style or length. Includes a wash if needed.
- Fade: $30. Skin fade, taper, or high-and-tight.
- Shape-up: $15. Hairline, edges, and temple definition.
- Head shave: $25. Finished with a hot towel.
- Beard trim: $15. Shaped, lined, and cleaned up.
- Straight razor shave: $30. Traditional straight razor.
- Hot towel shave: $30. Hot towel prep, straight razor finish.

## Barbers

- Roman: the site says he takes his time, and that some clients fly in from LA to sit in his chair.
- Jack: the site says he makes you feel welcome when you walk in, and that regulars have been coming for years.
- Alik: the site describes him as sharp, consistent, and fast, often about 20 minutes.

## Reviews

The homepage links to the shop's Google reviews and shows 4.8 from 269 reviews.

- Google reviews: https://search.google.com/local/reviews?placeid=ChIJCfulHFlZwokRs8meQ2tSokw
